title: Book Levels MicroSim
description: Interactive stair-step visualization showing the five levels of intelligent textbooks from static to autonomous AI.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Education
AI
Intelligent Textbooks
EdTech
learningObjectives: Identify the five stair-step levels of intelligent textbooks in order: Static, Interactive Content, Adaptive, Chatbot-enabled, and Autonomous AI
Distinguish Level 2 interactive content such as search, hyperlinks, and embedded MicroSims from Level 3 adaptivity, which adjusts content from learner performance data
Explain why Level 3 adaptive textbooks require concept graph traversal and data management systems that Level 2 textbooks do not
Evaluate the student-privacy trade-offs introduced when a textbook collects learning data to provide adaptivity
Classify a given textbook into one of the five levels based on its interactivity and personalization features
